# Runner Dashboard

> Fleet operator console and coordination API. Model execution MCPs live in sibling code repos; RD exposes coordination MCP tools and the REST API only.

## Agent connection

- [docs/agents/connect.md](docs/agents/connect.md): MCP, CLI, tokens, scopes, and generated MCP tool inventory.

## REST API

- [frontend/src/lib/openapi.json](frontend/src/lib/openapi.json): OpenAPI snapshot served at `GET /openapi.json`.

## MCP tool inventory

- [clients/fleet/README.md#mcp-tool-inventory](clients/fleet/README.md): Generated inventories for `fleet_mcp.py` and `rd_threads_mcp.py` (auth scope per tool).
